_doc: The EVN / CORE palette: the one source of every colour the project themes (theming audit, 2026-09-24).
Light is the CORE website's, checked against the live edu.coresg.tech (2026-09-24, its Blocksy palette in a saved
copy of the home page): 1 #a8977b accent, 2 #7f715c hover (our accentInk), 3 #3f4245 text, 4 #111518 headings,
5 #eaeaec borders (our line), 6 #f4f4f5 surfaces and footer (our surface), 7/8 #ffffff page; Jost, 16 px, 0.02em.
CORE puts white text on #a8977b (2.85:1); here white text sits on accentInk (4.75:1, WCAG AA) and text on a
surface uses accentDeep (accentInk on #f4f4f5 is 4.32:1). These departures, and the EVN site's dark footer where
CORE's is #f4f4f5, stay by the owner's decision (2026-09-24). Not CORE's but ours: surface2, lineStrong, grid,
muted, accentDeep, ok/danger, the code colours and the series. CORE's dark panels are rgba(18,21,25,.98): dark
is the EVN site's scheme on the brand ink #111518. series: data lines and charts (console
strip charts; the blocks' own category colours are evn_blocks.js PALETTE). scripts/test_theme.js checks every
copy below against this file - site.css, editor.css, editor.js, compassCoverage.ts, console.css, the icons,
package.json, site/index.html, build_web_ide.js - so a change here is a change there, or the test fails.
Policy: editor-area pages (the blocks editor, the compass map) and the website use this palette; views docked
in VS Code's side bars (Start, My projects, Board, Console) follow the VS Code theme, and take only the
series from here. Text colours are AA (4.5:1) on page and surface: okInk / codeNum / codeComment / codeFn are the
text forms of ok / series[0] / grey / blue; the light series are 3:1 (graphics) on VS Code's light panels (#f3f3f3).
(the light values above were verified against the live site on 2026-09-24).
